nodes.label: Advanced Text Splitting & Retrieval Techniques
nodes.description: Overview of various methods for processing and retrieving text, focusing on maintaining semantic coherence and providing rich context for Language Models (LLMs).

nodes.label: Recursive Character Text Splitting (RCTS)
nodes.description: A technique that iteratively splits text using a predefined list of separators (e.g., paragraphs, sentences, spaces) to keep semantically related pieces of text together.

nodes.label: Parent-Child Chunking
nodes.description: Involves embedding small text chunks (children) for precise retrieval, but then returning the larger surrounding document (parent) to the LLM to provide richer context.

nodes.label: Auto-merging Retriever
nodes.description: A retrieval method where if multiple child chunks belonging to the same parent node are retrieved, the retriever dynamically merges them and passes the whole parent node to the LLM.

nodes.label: Propositional Chunking
nodes.description: Utilizes an LLM to extract individual facts or 'propositions' from a document and embeds them independently, creating highly dense and precise retrieval targets.
